# ColorOS Live Lyrics Bridge v5.0.0

v5.0.0 是一次大版本更新：Bridge 有了独立的管理应用和 Provider 商店，专属 Provider 可以自己申请 LSPosed 作用域，Provider 不再随 Bridge Release 附带，改为在商店中按各自版本安装和更新。锁屏歌词的取词、渲染与 AOD 行为与 4.5.4 一致；内部结构做了大规模整理，并加入了功能级的安全降级。

## 管理应用

- 新的管理界面分为“首页 / 商店 / 外观 / 状态”四个标签，底部为悬浮导航。
- 首页显示 Bridge 模块是否运行、系统界面加载的版本与设置是否已推送；首次使用时有设置清单，按顺序检查环境、启用 Bridge、选择播放器、安装并启用 Provider，最后播放一次确认效果。
- 新增桌面图标，可在首页中隐藏；隐藏后仍可从 LSPosed 的模块设置进入。
- 升级后首次打开会显示一次“新版说明”。
- 外观标签显示当前歌词外观的摘要，编辑仍进入原有的歌词外观设置；重启系统界面的入口移到首页，并需要确认。

## Provider 商店

- 商店列出官方 Provider，并显示每个 Provider 的安装状态、可用更新，以及是否已在 LSPosed 中启用。
- 目录经过签名校验，下载的 APK 会校验大小、SHA-256 和签名证书，再交给系统安装器安装；中途取消或中断后可以继续。
- 启用状态：有 Root 时，Bridge 只读读取 LSPosed 的模块状态；没有 Root 时，读取新版 Provider 自带的状态接口。卡片上可以一键跳到 LSPosed。
- 可选的更新提醒默认关闭；开启后大约每天检查一次，只发通知，不会自动安装。
- 专属 Provider 可以在商店卡片上直接向 LSPosed 申请播放器作用域，由 LSPosed 弹窗确认，Bridge 不写入任何框架配置。
- 首次通过商店发布的版本：Salt 1.1.3、光锥 1.1.3、酷我 1.2.3、洛雪 1.2.3、Poweramp 1.2.2、酷狗 1.2.5、QQ 音乐 1.2.2、网易云 1.2.3、Apple Music 1.2.2、Spotify 1.1.3、汽水音乐 1.1.3、通用播放器 1.1.4、Readify 1.0.3，以及动态封面 Provider 1.0.6。

## 状态与诊断

- 状态标签按功能（自绘、取色、字符上浮、逐行与翻译进度、翻译按钮、动态封面、逐字进度）显示是否生效以及原因，例如未开启、没有原始歌词、AOD 低帧率、正在等待数据或已回退到官方效果。
- 新增 60 秒短时诊断：默认关闭，开启后记录关键状态变化，可生成离线摘要；不记录完整歌词、媒体 ID、Token、Cookie 或私人路径。
- 调试开关只影响日志和诊断记录。MEDIA 调试不再在动态封面与封面取色都关闭时单独启动封面观测。

## 兼容与稳定性

- 功能级安全降级：自绘、字符上浮、封面取色或翻译合成按钮在同一次系统界面插件加载中多次出错时，会暂停该项并使用官方效果或手动配色，其他功能不受影响。系统界面插件更新或更改歌词设置后会再次尝试；状态页会显示“多次出错，已暂停此项”。
- 已在 ColorOS 17（PJZ110）上完成设备验收。SystemUI 16.99.12 / 17.99.02 与 SystemUIPlugin 16.001.002 / 17.000.002 的其他已知构建已做静态兼容核对；其他型号未验证。
- 入口类按职责拆分（17,989 行减到 9,798 行），这部分不改变可见行为。

## 升级说明

1. 可直接覆盖安装 Bridge 5.0.0。Bridge 作用域仍为 system 与 com.android.systemui。
2. 本 Release 不再包含 Provider APK 或 Provider ZIP。请在 Bridge 的“商店”中安装或更新 Provider；已安装的 4.x Provider 可继续使用，但要显示启用状态、使用一键申请作用域，需要更新到商店中的版本。
3. **Metrolist 不再提供专属 Provider。** 商店中不再列出它，已安装的 Metrolist Provider 不会被自动移除；建议改用通用播放器 Provider。
4. 同一播放器只开一个 Provider：专属 Provider 与通用播放器 Provider 二选一，同时开启会互相覆盖 lyricInfo。
5. 新增的应用权限都只用于管理应用本身：联网（读取商店目录与下载 Provider）、安装应用（交给系统安装器）、通知（可选的更新提醒）、开机启动（恢复更新提醒的定时任务）。系统界面一侧的 Hook 不使用这些权限。
6. Debug 签名测试包不能覆盖正式签名包，需要先卸载。从 4.0 或更早版本升级前，仍建议在 Bridge 中完成配置备份。

## 资产

正式 Release 只包含 3 项：ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Bridge-v5.0.0.apk、release-assets-v5.0.0.json 和 SHA256SUMS。Provider 从 Providers 仓库按各自的 tag 发布，并通过签名目录分发。

---

# English

v5.0.0 is a major update. The Bridge gains its own management app and a Provider store, dedicated Providers can request their own LSPosed scope, and Providers no longer ship inside the Bridge Release: each is installed and updated from the store at its own version. Lock-screen lyric intake, rendering and AOD behaviour are the same as 4.5.4; the internals were reorganised at scale and gained feature-level safe fallbacks.

## Management app

- A new management UI with four tabs (Home, Store, Appearance, Status) and a floating bottom bar.
- Home shows whether the Bridge module is running, which version System UI loaded and whether settings were pushed. On first use a setup checklist walks through the environment, enabling the Bridge, choosing a player, installing and enabling a Provider, and playing once to confirm.
- A launcher icon is added and can be hidden from Home; the app stays reachable from the module settings in LSPosed.
- A one-time "What's new" card appears after the upgrade.
- The Appearance tab shows a summary of the current lyric look; editing still opens the existing lyric appearance settings. Restarting System UI moved to Home and asks for confirmation.

## Provider store

- The store lists the official Providers with their install state, available updates and whether each is enabled in LSPosed.
- The catalog is signature-checked. Downloaded APKs are checked for size, SHA-256 and signing certificate before the system installer takes over; a cancelled or interrupted install can be resumed.
- Enabled state: with root, the Bridge reads LSPosed module state read-only; without root, it asks the status endpoint built into the new Providers. Each card can jump straight to LSPosed.
- Optional update reminders are off by default; when on, they check about once a day and only notify, never install.
- Dedicated Providers can ask LSPosed for their player scope straight from the store card. LSPosed shows the confirmation; the Bridge never writes framework configuration.
- First store versions: Salt 1.1.3, Cone 1.1.3, KuWo 1.2.3, LX 1.2.3, Poweramp 1.2.2, KuGou 1.2.5, QQ Music 1.2.2, NetEase 1.2.3, Apple Music 1.2.2, Spotify 1.1.3, QiShui 1.1.3, Universal 1.1.4, Readify 1.0.3, and Dynamic Artwork Provider 1.0.6.

## Status and diagnostics

- The Status tab shows, per feature (custom drawing, cover colour, character lift, line and translation progress, translation button, dynamic artwork, word progress), whether it is in effect and why not: turned off, no raw lyric, AOD low frame rate, waiting for data, or fell back to the official look.
- A 60-second short diagnostic session, off by default, records key state changes and can produce an offline summary. It never records full lyrics, media IDs, tokens, cookies or private paths.
- Debug switches only affect logging and diagnostic recording. MEDIA debug no longer starts artwork observation on its own while dynamic artwork and cover colour are both off.

## Compatibility and stability

- Feature-level safe fallback: if custom drawing, character lift, cover colour or the synthetic translation button fails repeatedly within one System UI plugin load, that feature pauses and the official look or manual colour is used; other features are unaffected. It is retried after a System UI plugin update or a lyric settings change, and the Status tab says it was paused.
- Device-accepted on ColorOS 17 (PJZ110). Other known builds of SystemUI 16.99.12 / 17.99.02 and SystemUIPlugin 16.001.002 / 17.000.002 were checked for static compatibility; other models are not verified.
- The entry class was split by responsibility (17,989 to 9,798 lines) with no visible behaviour change.

## Upgrading

1. Install Bridge 5.0.0 over the previous version. The Bridge scope stays system and com.android.systemui.
2. This Release no longer contains Provider APKs or a Provider ZIP. Install or update Providers from the Bridge Store. Installed 4.x Providers keep working, but showing their enabled state and the one-tap scope request need the store versions.
3. **Metrolist no longer has a dedicated Provider.** It is gone from the store; an installed Metrolist Provider is not removed. The Universal Player Provider is the suggested replacement.
4. Enable only one Provider per player: a dedicated Provider or the Universal Player Provider, not both, or they overwrite each other's lyricInfo.
5. The new app permissions serve the management app only: network (store catalog and Provider downloads), install packages (hand-off to the system installer), notifications (optional update reminders) and boot completed (restoring the reminder schedule). The System UI hooks do not use them.
6. A debug-signed test build cannot be installed over a release-signed one; uninstall first. Back up your configuration in the Bridge before upgrading from 4.0 or earlier.

## Assets

The Release contains exactly 3 assets: ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Bridge-v5.0.0.apk, release-assets-v5.0.0.json and SHA256SUMS. Providers are released from the Providers repository under their own tags and distributed through the signed catalog.
